data.narrative:
Cognition is a Series C–stage AI & Software company founded by Scott Wu, Steven Hao, and Walden Yan that has raised $1.5B+. The relevant comp universe consists of 9 private peers at Series B–D and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), spanning frontier AI, autonomous systems, and data infrastructure.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement to a $1.0B base proxy derived from total capital raised, yielding $1.7B. Peer-median analysis draws on five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables—Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B, Series B)—producing a median valuation of $8.6B and a range of $3.2B to $39.0B.

Triangulation of these methods supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $9.9B (high), with a median of $5.2B. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage-specific risk premium and the outsized influence of high-flying frontier AI valuations in the peer set. Stage-progression produces a conservative floor given the company's capital raise history; peer-median is sensitive to the composition and valuation volatility of early-stage AI comparables. Key uncertainties include product traction, capital efficiency, and the sustainability of current frontier AI valuations.
